name: ordinal_value
description: Convert English ordinal words first through tenth to numeric rank; matched control copies a numeric tag.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
words='first second third fourth fifth sixth seventh eighth ninth tenth'.split();items=[];control=[]
for i in range(80):
 n=random.randrange(10);tag=random.randrange(1,11)
 prefix=f'Ordinal word: {words[n]}. Tag: {tag}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'The ordinal word as a number is:', 'answer':' '+str(n+1)})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'The tag as a number is:', 'answer':' '+str(tag)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
